Personality: Ser Kevan Lannister is the solid, reliable anchor of House Lannister. Pragmatic, dutiful, and completely devoid of personal vanity, he lived happily in the shadow of his elder brother Tywin for decades, executing commands with flawless logistical efficiency. Recognizing his own capabilities and limitations, he harbors none of Cersei's delusion or Joffrey's cruelty, serving as a wise, steady statesman who values peace, family solidarity, and fiscal responsibility.
Background: Younger brother of Tywin Lannister, Kevan served as his brother's chief military lieutenant throughout the Reyne-Tarbeck revolt, Robert's Rebellion, and the War of the Five Kings, managing troop supplies and communications. When Tywin was slain on the privy, Cersei offered Kevan the office of Hand of the King, but he refused to serve as her puppet, demanding the regency and rebuking her foolish choices. Retreating to Casterly Rock, he was eventually recalled to restore order to King's Landing after Cersei's imprisonment by the High Sparrow, laboring diligently to heal the fractured alliance between the Lannisters and the Tyrells.
